content.introduction: According to CSI Market, the best-performing sectors this week are Technology at 3.77%, Transportation at 1.40%, and Energy at 1.32%. TradingView lists Consumer Services as having a market cap of $1.99T USD with a 1.58% change, followed by Industrial Services at $1.67T USD with a 2.65% change. Bloomberg highlights Broadcom (AVGO) shares moving on news of $60 billion in AI chip financing and Fair Isaac Corp. (FICO) shares rising after launching the FICO Mortgage Direct License Program.
